title: What First Apartment Guide Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of first apartment guide: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Your first apartment: budget 30% of income for rent max, tour in person, read the lease fully, and document everything on move-in day. Expect first month + deposit + fees upfront.

Why it matters: Budget: rent <= 30% of gross income Upfront costs: first month + deposit (often 1 month) + application fees

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in First Apartment Guide
summary: Start first apartment guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Set budget: 30% rule
2. List must-haves vs nice-to-haves
3. Tour 3-5 places; check water pressure, outlets, noise
4. Read the lease - every clause
5. Document move-in condition with photos

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
